items.title: Fast & Furious returns to Pop! Rides with Dom's '70 Charger and '87 Buick Grand National and Letty's '66 Stingray, #163–#165
items.summary: Three Fast & Furious Super Deluxe Pop! Rides: Dom with his 1970 Dodge Charger #163 ($34.99 on Funko.com), Dom with the 1987 Buick Grand National #164 and Letty with her 1966 Corvette Stingray #165; US pre-orders opened Nov. 27 at Entertainment Earth and Amazon.

items.title: Black Torch gets its first Funko Pop! wave: Jiro Azuma (with chase), Rago, Ichika and Reiji, plus a Funko Shop-exclusive Amagi
items.summary: First Pop! figures for Tsuyoshi Takaki's Black Torch manga: Jiro Azuma #2650 with a chase variant, the black cat Rago #2651, Ichika Kishimojin #2652, Reiji Kirihara #2653, and villain Amagi #2654 as a Funko.com web exclusive at $14.99. Pre-orders opened Nov. 25.

items.title: Crunchyroll Store launches an exclusive Frieren & Fern Funko Pop! 2-pack for Black Friday at $29.99
items.summary: A Crunchyroll Store-exclusive Pop! 2-pack of Frieren and her apprentice Fern from Frieren: Beyond Journey's End is now available to order for $29.99.

items.title: Disney's Hexed opens in theaters with a Pop! of Beef Roger Crummchuk, #1843
items.summary: Funko's Pop! Disney Beef Roger Crummchuk from Disney Animation's Hexed, box #1843, about 3.3 inches tall, $14.99 and listed as Coming Soon on Funko.com. Hexed opened in theaters Nov. 25.

items.title: Voltron's five lions get their own Pop! Television figures, #1994–#1998
items.summary: Classic Voltron: Defender of the Universe lions as single Pops: Blue Lion #1994, Black Lion #1995, Red Lion #1996, Green Lion #1997 and Yellow Lion #1998, $14.99 each, US pre-orders from Nov. 25 at retailers like Entertainment Earth and Amazon, arriving about January 2027.

items.title: Funko Pop! Mystery blind boxes launch in Brazil through Candide, starting with KPop Demon Hunters and a one-of-one chase Funko will buy back for $10,000
items.summary: Funko's Pop! Mystery blind-box line arrives officially in Brazil via exclusive distributor Candide, debuting with KPop Demon Hunters: six regular characters, a 1-in-72 Mystery Chase, and a single worldwide 1-of-1 Chase Global that the finder can sell back to Funko for US$10,000. One Piece, Sanrio, Harry Potter and Shrek are planned next.

items.title: Funko brings seven Event Edition Pop! exclusives to CCXP26 in São Paulo, including Wanda Maximoff, Chopper, Anya and Beerus
items.summary: Funko announced seven Pop! Event Edition exclusives for CCXP26 (Dec. 3-6, São Paulo Expo): Stitch with cake, Tony Tony Chopper, Anya Forger in detective outfit with magnifying glass, Beerus, Wanda Maximoff in a statue look covered in vegetation, Princess Vivi and Pompompurin. Sold only at Funko's booth, no online sales, while supplies last.

items.title: Funko launches KPop Demon Hunters Bitty POP! 4-packs in three series at $14.99 each
items.summary: Tiny 0.9-inch Bitty POP! figures of the KPop Demon Hunters crew in stackable acrylic cases, four per pack; Series 1 has Bobby, Mira, Derpy Tiger and Romance Saja. $14.99 each, listed as coming soon on Funko's site.

items.title: New Pokémon Pop! wave: Chikorita, Nidoking, Nidoqueen and Vaporeon, #1355–#1358, plus a four-Pop Pokémon Bundle
items.summary: Funko's new Pokémon Pop! Games wave: Chikorita #1355, Nidoking #1356, Nidoqueen #1357 and Vaporeon #1358 ($14.99, coming soon on Funko.com), going on sale Nov. 25 alongside a Pokémon Bundle of Venusaur, Charizard, Blastoise and Pikachu.

items.title: Rurouni Kenshin gets its first Funko Pop! figures: Kenshin Himura #2689 with a chase, and Makoto Shishio #2690
items.summary: Funko's first Rurouni Kenshin Pops: Kenshin Himura #2689 with a chase variant and Makoto Shishio #2690, $14.99 each on Funko.com, US pre-orders from Nov. 25.

items.title: Funko's 2026 Bitty Pop! Countdown Calendars bring 24 days of Pokémon, Star Wars and Hello Kitty & Friends minis
items.summary: Three Bitty Pop! Countdown Calendars for Christmas 2026, Pokémon, Star Wars and Hello Kitty & Friends, each with 24 days of miniature collectibles.

items.title: Funko adds Liverpool's Isak, Szoboszlai and Ekitiké and Man City's Donnarumma and Rúben Dias to Pop! Football
items.summary: Five new Pop! Football figures numbered #116 to #120: Alexander Isak, Dominik Szoboszlai and Hugo Ekitiké in Liverpool red, plus goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma and defender Rúben Dias for Manchester City, each in club kit on a grass base with a ball. Pre-orders are open for a January 2027 release.

items.title: Funko Shop's four November limited editions drop Nov. 23: Cyber Corrupted Sonic (1,200 pcs), Kevin Owens (3,500), metallic Howard the Duck (5,000) and Black Widow Black Suit (7,500)
items.summary: Funko's limited edition drop calendar lists four Nov. 23 drops: Pop! Cyber Corrupted Sonic with Pop! Protector ($39.99, 1,200 pieces), Pop! Kevin Owens with Pop! Protector ($29.99, 3,500), Pop! Howard the Duck (Power Cosmic) (Metallic) with Pop! Protector ($24.99, 5,000) and Pop! Black Widow (Black Suit) ($19.99, 7,500).

items.title: Funko opens a limited-time web-exclusive Pop! TheBurntPeanut, on pre-order through Dec. 14
items.summary: Pop! Icons TheBurntPeanut is a peanut-shaped figure of the live-streaming content creator, about 3.9 inches tall, a $14.99 Funko.com web exclusive available for pre-order from November 18 through December 14, 2026.

items.title: Hatsune Miku gets her first new Funko Pop! since 2021: a roller-skating Diner Version with a 1-in-6 diamond chase
items.summary: Pop! Hatsune Miku (Diner Version) #2636 shows the virtual singer as a retro diner waitress on roller skates with turquoise pigtails. Funko lists it as coming soon at $14.99 with a 1 in 6 chance of a sparkly diamond chase.

items.title: Funko unveils Avengers: Doomsday Thor and Dune: Part Three Pops, including a Paul Atreides with Sandworm Pop! Moment
items.summary: Funko's new film lineup adds a Thor Pop! and a Bitty Pop! Avengers: Doomsday 4-pack, a Loungefly Doctor Doom light-up mini backpack, and Dune: Part Three Pops of Paul Atreides with Sandworm (Pop! Moment #2155), a bloodied Alia Atreides and Chani.

items.title: Amazon-exclusive Avengers: Doomsday Mystique Pop!, limited to 5,000, drops Nov. 25 at noon ET for $19.99
items.summary: Mystique from Avengers: Doomsday, blue textured skin, red hair, yellow eyes, white outfit and skull headpiece; Amazon exclusive limited edition of 5,000, $19.99, Nov. 25 at noon ET.

items.title: Funko reveals Harry Potter Bitty Loungefly house 3-packs with a 1-in-48 Chocolate Frog chase
items.summary: Four Hogwarts house Bitty Loungefly three-packs (Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw, Slytherin) with mini backpacks in stackable acrylic cases; each pack has a 1-in-48 chance of a rare Chocolate Frog backpack chase with a canvas dust bag.

items.title: Step Brothers and Talladega Nights Pops open for pre-order: Brennan, Dale, Ricky Bobby & Cal, and Jean Girard
items.summary: New Pop! Movies waves: Step Brothers Brennan Huff #2193, Dale Doback #2194 and a 2-pack, plus Talladega Nights Ricky Bobby & Cal Naughton Jr. 2-pack and Jean Girard #2202 ($14.99), with pre-orders opening Nov. 19.

items.title: Entertainment Earth opens pre-orders for an exclusive Prisoner Bon Clay One Piece Pop!
items.summary: Entertainment Earth opened pre-orders on Nov. 18 for a limited-edition exclusive One Piece Pop! of Bon Clay in his prison outfit, priced at $16.99 with an estimated January 2027 arrival.

items.title: French judo champion Teddy Riner gets a Funko.com-exclusive Pop! #98
items.summary: Funko's web-exclusive Pop! Teddy Riner #98 ($14.99) honors the French judo champion in his judogi; it is about 3.7 inches tall and comes with Octane5 authentication packaging.

items.title: Funko and Loungefly kick off a Black Friday sale with up to 70% off through Nov. 29
items.summary: Funko.com and Loungefly.com are running a Black Friday sale with up to 70% off marked items from Nov. 16 through Nov. 29, 2026. Pre-orders and limited edition items are excluded.

items.title: Funko slots new Infinity Saga Pops of Tony Stark, Steve Rogers and Bucky between its Avengers: Doomsday waves
items.summary: New Marvel Infinity Saga Pops numbered #1671-#1674, including Steve Rogers (Chopping Wood) #1671, Tony Stark (Nanotech Suit) #1672 and Bucky #1673, sit right next to the Avengers: Doomsday Pop! waves ahead of the film's December release.

items.title: Funko's next Hazbin Hotel wave brings Adam, Vox, Husk, Niffty and Emily
items.summary: Funko teased a new Hazbin Hotel collection on X. Funko.com lists Pop! Adam (Winner Archangel) with a chance of chase, Vox, Husk and Niffty as coming soon, plus a web-exclusive Emily (Seraphim Angel), each $14.99.

items.title: Plastic Empire opens pre-orders for an exclusive glow-in-the-dark Doc Brown & Einstein Pop!
items.summary: Plastic Empire's Back to the Future Plutonium Glow Doc Brown & Einstein Pop! & Buddy went up for pre-order on Nov. 12 at 10:04 PM ET for $19.99, with fewer than 5,000 available; a $249 Christopher Lloyd-signed, JSA-authenticated Signature Series was offered for 88 hours. Estimated shipping is December to January.

items.title: Dunk and Egg from A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms get Funko Pop! figures
items.summary: Funko's new Pop! figures of Ser Duncan the Tall and Egg from HBO's A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms are up for pre-order at Entertainment Earth for about $15 each.

items.title: Funko sends Michael Jordan back up for Space Jam’s game-winning shot
items.summary: Funko’s new Pop! Movies Space Jam Michael Jordan figure puts the star in his Tune Squad uniform, mid-air for the game-winning shot. The 4.6-inch vinyl is $14.99 and is listed on Funko.com as a pre-order shipping November 24, 2026, for the film’s 30th anniversary.

items.title: Funko’s Professor Pyg GameStop exclusive arrives in the classic black apron
items.summary: The Batman Professor Pyg GameStop exclusive dropped at midnight PST on November 11, limited to 9,500 pieces at $19.99, wearing the classic black butcher’s apron and red tie. ComicBook.com independently listed the same November 11 GameStop exclusive, price, and 9,500-piece limit.

items.title: Archer gets its first Funko Pop! wave: Sterling, Malory, Pam and Krieger
items.summary: Funko's debut Archer Pop! wave covers Sterling Archer, Malory Archer, Pam Poovey and Dr. Krieger as Pop! #2640-#2643, with two Chase variants including a black turtleneck Sterling.

items.title: Psyren gets its first Funko Pop! figures, led by the Drifters and Nemesis Q
items.summary: Funko's first Psyren Pop! Animation wave: Yoshina Ageha #2607, Amamiya Sakurako #2608 with a 1-in-6 sword Chase, Asaga Hiryu #2609, Kirisaki Kabuto #2610 and Nemesis Q #2611.
